_comment: JP's own runtime knobs (the Global server reads server/client_config.json). Every key is documented in server/CONFIG_GUIDE_JP.md.
_banner_max_age_days: gacha/index listing age limit. null = every banner; 30 = only banners still running at some point in the last 30 days (end_date within 30 days of servertime). Open-ended/upcoming banners and gacha_odds.json "on": true always stay listed.
_testing_knobs: Testing knobs, all null = real behaviour. force_ssr_rate: gacha SSR % per draw (0-100). force_failure_rate: every training's failure % (0-100). force_training_gain: every stat + skill points pinned to this number. training_gain_multiplier: scales the real formula's stat + skill point gains (e.g. 2 = double). See CONFIG_GUIDE_JP.md.
